mapper.insert: INSERT INTO expert_user (member_id, is_online, approve_status, approved_date, specialty, expert_introduce, profile_image_path) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{isOnline}, 0, NULL, #{specialty}, #{expertIntroduce}, #{profileImagePath})

INSERT INTO certification (certification_id, member_id, cert_name, issuer, cert_no, issued_date, expired_date, cert_file_path, verify_status, verified_date, reject_reason, created_date) VALUES (#{certificationId}, #{memberId}, #{certName}, #{issuer}, #{certNo}, #{issuedDate}, #{expiredDate}, #{certFilePath}, 0, NULL, NULL, NOW())

INSERT INTO expert_career (expert_id, organization, career_id, career_month,career_year, medical_departments,is_employed) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{organization}, #{careerId}, #{careerMonth}, #{careerYear}, #{medicalDepartments}, #{isEmployed})

INSERT INTO expert_career2 (expert_id, expert_school, expert_major, career_id, degree_name, graduation_yn) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{expertSchool}, #{expertMajor}, #{careerId}, #{degreeName}, #{graduationYn})

INSERT INTO expert_settlement (member_id, start_dt, end_dt, cons_cnt, tot_amt, curr_amt, paid_amt, bank_name, acct_no, pay_yn) VALUES (#{memberId}, #{startDt}, #{endDt}, #{consCnt}, #{totAmt}, #{currAmt}, #{paidAmt}, #{bankName}, #{acctNo}, 0)
mapper.select: SELECT approve_status FROM expert_user WHERE member_id = #{memberId}
SELECT m.member_id, m.name, eu.specialty, eu.expert_introduce, eu.is_online AS isOnline FROM member m JOIN expert_user eu ON m.member_id = eu.member_id WHERE m.member_id = #{expertId}
mapper.update: UPDATE expert_career2 SET expert_school = #{expertSchool}, expert_major = #{expertMajor}, degree_name = #{degreeName}, graduation_yn = #{graduationYn} WHERE career_id = #{careerId}
